title.en: missing_sensor_no_fallback: the one refusal a person present cannot lift

goal.en: Deep frying has a single rung, an oil thermometer. A robot that lists the operation but lacks the sensor is refused with a person present, with or without estimates; a robot that does not list the operation hands the frying to the person.

note.en: The basic hob robot lists deep_fry but has no oil thermometer: thirteen steps are planned, then refused at n14.

expect.refusal.detail: no way to verify cw.op.deep_fry on this device

note.en: Forbidding estimates changes nothing here: a model was never a rung for deep frying.
The hob robot with thermometers does not list deep_fry at all, so the person fries the onions and the rest is the robot's.
The fryer robot has the sensor: the device fries, verified by the oil thermometer.

outcome.en: You know the difference between claiming an operation and being able to verify it, and that a capability document should not list deep_fry without an oil thermometer. Next: scenario 034 runs the fryer robot with estimates forbidden.
